Description:
High heels and narrow toe boxes crowd your big toe toward your other toes, skipping toe strengthening lets your forefoot arch weaken, and sticking with tight shoes anyway locks the joint into place over time. Choose a wide toe box and lower heel, do toe-spreading stretches and towel-scrunch exercises daily, and try a toe spacer to ease the pressure.
